acquisition_wedge.rationale: Release Guardian is the highest-ranking flagship (top-1 to top-3 on breaking-change intents, score 28-39, health 1.0). Its only direct-equivalent dispatch-eligible competitor (delx) is $0.002. Setting the launch Quick price to $0.001 makes GENESIS the cheapest deterministic breaking-change check while it builds independent settlement history. Deep tier unchanged ($0.019).

unit_economics_note: Quick is deterministic with zero upstream cost; the only variable is the x402 facilitator settlement fee. $0.001 is the floor specified by the directive and remains above zero marginal compute cost. If facilitator settlement fees later prove negative at this price, the next economically-safe price above the cheapest direct equivalent ($0.002) should be used.
